files.source: .lb-filters{margin:1rem 0;color:inherit}.lb-filter-fields{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.lb-filter-fields label{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0;max-width:100%;font-size:.85rem}.lb-filter-fields label:first-child{flex:1 1 260px}.lb-filter-fields input,.lb-filter-fields select{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:100%;min-width:0;border:1px solid #c9c4ce;border-radius:8px;padding:10px;background:#fff;color:#29242e;font:inherit}.lb-stage-options,.lb-active-conditions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.lb-filters button{max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;border:1px solid #b9adb9;border-radius:20px;background:transparent;padding:9px 12px;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.lb-filters button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#513d55;color:white}.lb-filters button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}.lb-filters :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #83558d;outline-offset:3px}.lb-empty-reason{line-height:1.6}.lb-browser{min-width:0;max-width:100%}.lb-browser-readonly{font-size:.85rem;color:#655d68}

body{margin:0;background:#f8f5f9;color:#2d2631;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}main{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:20px;box-sizing:border-box}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.5}.demo-toolbar{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}.demo-toolbar label{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}.demo-card{width:100%;min-width:0;border:1px solid #c5b8cb;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:white;text-align:left;color:inherit;padding:0}.demo-card strong,.demo-card span{display:block;padding:10px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.demo-placeholder{display:grid;place-items:center;background:#ddd1e1;color:#624b70}main :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #885ba0;outline-offset:3px}textarea{display:block;max-width:100%;box-sizing:border-box}section>label{display:block;margin:12px 0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important}}

[data-demo-restore]{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:break-word;max-width:100%}
